premises.text: Commercial aviation packs passengers like cattle while private jets cost about 5,000 euros, leaving no middle option
premises.evidence_span: There's two options. Be treated like cattle or pay 5,000 euros

premises.text: A marketplace connecting private pilots with passengers lets them share flight costs and makes private aviation accessible
premises.evidence_span: Wingly makes private aviation accessible to everybody by connecting private pilots with passengers so they can share the cost of a flight

premises.text: The platform handles booking end-to-end including payments, pricing, matching, suggestions, pilot vetting, and insurance
premises.evidence_span: the platform takes care of everything for you. Online payments, pricing algorithm, smart matching, flight suggestion, pilot vetting, and insurance

premises.text: Flight Request lets passengers request a flight to private pilots when no matching flight is yet posted
premises.evidence_span: It's the first platform to actually allow you to request a flight to a private pilot easily

premises.text: A 2016 regulatory change clarifies that private pilots may share flight costs and advertise flights beforehand
premises.evidence_span: a 2016 regulatory change made it clear for private pilots that they're allowed to share the cost of a flight and also advertise it on light beforehand

premises.text: A tailor-made insurance product adds 1 million euro coverage on marketplace flights
premises.evidence_span: We developed a tailor-made insurance product that allows us to offer all our customers an extra 1 million euro coverage on all the flights you do

premises.text: European private pilots fly with empty seats that can be filled via the marketplace
premises.evidence_span: They are more than 300,000, flying around 4 million hours per year, in average with 2 to 2.5 empty seats

premises.text: The marketplace takes a commission of 15% plus 4 euros per transaction
